method: Deterministic classification of Discovery-V2 retrieval hits using only subheading text metadata already present in the frozen artifact (no chunk prose read, no embeddings, no new source access). GENERIC_HEADINGS is a fixed allowlist of structural/process-label headings (Treatment, Management, Investigations, Differential diagnosis, Complications, Approach, History and Physical Exam, Overview, Presentation, Diagnosis, Etiology, Epidemiology, Prognosis, Workup, Clinical features, Risk factors, Consent and Capacity, History, Physical Exam, Purpose). A subheading string that is not in that list but reads as a body-text sentence fragment (lowercase start, or ends mid-clause) is classified OTHER rather than SPECIFIC_HEADING_IDENTITY, since it cannot be safely trusted as a clean structural heading without reading prose.

phase1_phelo08_independent_review.reason: MAID eligibility assessment under Bill C-14 is a specific, clinically real, and legally distinct ethical action from decision-specific capacity assessment -- capacity is a necessary but not sufficient MAID criterion, so the two are not the same construct at different granularity. Same response class family (AUTONOMY) and same ETHICAL_ACTION granularity as the key, so it is a plausible same-lane distractor for a stem where a learner might wrongly jump to 'assess MAID eligibility' instead of the narrower 'assess capacity for this specific decision.' Low collision risk with the key. Approved as cache-eligible pending relation authoring (positive anchor, inferiority discriminator, evidence) -- this review covers candidate identity/plausibility only, not a completed Clinical Contrast Relation V2.

phase7_resolver_design_not_implemented.minimal_design_if_implemented: priority order: (1) EXISTING_REVIEWED_IDENTITY for the same chunk_id/concept_id if a prior approved seed/relation already references it; (2) CANONICAL_CONCEPT_IDENTITY via concept_mentions.concept_id -> concepts.preferred_label join on chunk_id; (3) SPECIFIC_HEADING_IDENTITY when subheading is not in the generic-heading allowlist and is not a caption/body-text fragment (colon, 'Figure'/'Table' prefix, lowercase-initial, dangling-preposition ending); (4) TOC_PATH_IDENTITY fallback using chunks.section_path's last 1-2 segments only when (1)-(3) fail and the path segment is more specific than the opportunity's own study-unit topic; else CANDIDATE_IDENTITY_NOT_RESOLVABLE. No embeddings, no generative labeling.
